ablation_method: Region r's embedding is zeroed after per-region processing (projection + graph-diffusion + attention pooling) and before cross-region self-attention, so region r also does not participate in other regions' cross-region attention. After cross-region LayerNorm, position r is zeroed again. no_renorm: original normalised weights kept (w still sums to 1, region r contributes w[r]*0=0). renorm: w[r] forced to 0 and remaining weights renormalised to sum to 1.
evaluation: out-of-bag (OOB) patients only; in-sample c-index is not reported
note: Rounds run in parallel shards (1-6, 7-12, 13-16, 17-20) and merged.
